title: Blackboard Blogging #OpenEd19
summary: In reply to Laura It is ugly and superficial, but I add an RSS feed and encourage people to bring their own website. So I wanted my instructional design to be parallel. The content though gets sperated from external and internal blogs I want webmentions back, more fun, more interactivity #ungradingnet #OpenEd19
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
In reply to Laura

It is ugly and superficial, but I add an RSS feed and encourage people to bring their own website. So I wanted my instructional design to be parallel. The content though gets sperated from external and internal blogs

I want webmentions back, more fun, more interactivity

#ungradingnet #OpenEd19
